sources.authoring_assessment: Sequential hypothesis tests require explicit nulls, evidence relevance, stopping rules and denominators. Gene-level task identities remain uninventoried; permuted-data controls are not observed training data.

required_stages: define measurable implications and valid nulls
join independent observations with explicit identity and population rules
execute statistical tests with reproducible test statistics
combine evidence with an explicit sequential stopping rule
report unsupported as well as supported claims
source_protocols: Two cytokine endpoints, each with observed-data and permuted-data protocols; repeated model runs are not new biological tasks.

The provided shell experiment requests 20 selected positive hypotheses and 50 permuted-data controls per endpoint. Identities are selected from external score tables, so these requested counts do not establish an enumerated release.
scientific_decisions: The source metric called false discovery rate divides false positives by the negative-control count; that is a false-positive rate. A fresh contract must name its denominator accurately.
Permutation controls are altered observations for calibration, not real-data training tasks.

Numerically correct testing does not itself establish relevance of a measurable implication to the biological hypothesis. Specify that relationship in an adapted task; do not use an LLM relevance judgment as its reward.
remaining_gaps: Obtain a stable permitted task-identity manifest without using ground-truth scores to author training examples.
Verify source data lineage and test independence before claiming error control or scientific workflow coverage.
protocol_assessment.execution: not run; no source inputs, ground-truth tables or model calls used
